reset_confirm_body: Every Check, Sign-off, notice and report made in this demo is cleared, and the seeded shop comes back.

course_passport_locked: Finish all four doors to earn the stamp.

course_seq_hint: Tap the steps in the right order.
course_inspect_tap: Tap each dot to check that point.
lp_h1: Understood at work. Understood at home.
lp_lead: A foreman's 20-second voice note becomes a simple Japanese and English instruction pinned to the machine. The machine stays locked until the worker proves they understood.
lp_problem_lead: Foreign workers are on Japanese shop floors, but instructions still arrive in a language many of them cannot fully follow.
lp_stat1: of employers say limited Japanese makes communication hard. It is the most cited challenge, up from 43.9%.
lp_stat2: injuries per 1,000 workers: technical interns 3.98, Specified Skilled 3.91, against 2.3 for all workers.
lp_source: Source: MHLW, Survey on Foreign Workers’ Employment 2025 (published 2026-08-31)
lp_gap_lead: Good tools already translate manuals and run tests. Of 22 products we checked, none do these two things.
lp_done1: カミナシ translates manuals and runs tests in 18 languages, Bengali included.
lp_done2: Teachme Biz runs tests and opens manuals from QR codes on site.
lp_only1: The Check gates one specific machine: the Machine Panel stays locked for that worker until they pass.
lp_only2: Every wrong answer tells the foreman which shop word was misunderstood, such as 玉掛け, and is written into the record a registered support organisation must keep.
lp_how1: The foreman records a 20-second voice note at the machine.
lp_how2: Each worker gets it in simple Japanese or English, with a Japanese back-translation the foreman can check.
lp_how3: The worker answers 2 or 3 questions. Each question tests one shop word.
lp_how4: The tablet beside the machine shows LOCK until the worker passes. No install: a QR sticker goes on each machine.
lp_life: Neighbourhood notices, such as garbage rules and drills, become plain steps with dates in the worker’s calendar. A Japanese Senpai links the worker to their street. A support log exports the support record for 特定技能 duties.
lp_course: Training that sticks: read it, watch it, drill it, inspect it.
lp_biz: Free for the company and its workers. Paid for by registered support organisations (登録支援機関).
course_library_sub: Pick a course. Each has a story, a reel, drills, an equipment check and a quiz.
